body:
As I glance at the communal board, my eyes lock onto the unfamiliar key, its intricate pattern catching my attention. The room feels stifled with an unwarranted sense of dread as I realize it’s not just any key but one belonging to someone who has access only through special permissions. My heart races; I can't help but feel like this might be some kind of prank or misunderstanding, but something feels off about this situation.

I take a deep breath, trying to maintain my composure, before deciding to approach the board more carefully next time. Today, however, a confrontation seems inevitable—this feeling of being watched from the shadows is too much to ignore.
